analysis.title: 从模型竞速走向产品、算力与生态：本期 AI 趋势观察
analysis.lead: 本期共整理 129 条有效信号。下面不是新闻复述，而是把论文、公司、创业与政策放在同一张图里后的编辑性判断。
paragraphs: 研究侧共收录 20 条信号，重点包括 《BACE: LLM-based Code Generation through Bayesian Anchored…》、《Reward Hacking Benchmark: Measuring Exploits in LLM Agents…》。与只看榜单相比，更值得持续观察的是论文能否把 Agent 的可靠性、评测完整性与推理成本一起向前推进。
AI 跨领域贡献收录 16 条，代表性事件包括 《Claude Fable 5 协助找到雅可比猜想的显式三维反例》、《Sharing AI progress in mathematics》。这类结果会区分官方论文、可核验反例、媒体报道与尚待同行评审的社交平台首发，避免把‘可计算验证’和‘完成学术确认’混为一谈。
中国 AI 板块本期收录 16 条动态，已覆盖 Qwen / 通义千问、DeepSeek、字节豆包 / Seed。代表性变化包括 《英伟达重金力捧 “美版 DeepSeek ”将 发布 开源模型》、《通义千问 · Qwen -Image-2.1-Pro 透明图层+换背景全包了,小白也能用的＂轻量…》；竞争正在从单次模型发布延伸到开源策略、Agent 产品入口、国产算力适配和价格体系。
产业侧共有 30 条前沿实验室与大厂动态、14 条关键人物公开信号，另有 11 条创业和 10 条政策安全更新。模型能力、算力供给、创始人判断、产品分发与合规成本正在变成同一个竞争问题。

items.summary: Biology doesn't operate in silos, and neither should the AI representation of it. Quine is an early-stage research effort to create a multimodal world model of biology. items.summary: BACE treats generated code and tests as co-evolving populations instead of accepting synthetic tests as ground truth. The authors report strong results on LiveCodeBench v6 across proprietary and open-weight models.

items.title: A TSP solving model based on multiscale feature fusion and adaptive context awareness
items.summary: Transformer-based deep reinforcement learning for the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) often struggles to capture spatial topology and avoid local optima. To address this, we propose a novel model featuring a Multi-Scale Grid Attention Encoder (MSGAE) to fuse local and global spatial features, alongside a bottleneck-enhanced adaptive decoder (BMA) to prevent local optima. Optimized via multi-start Monte Carlo sampling, the model balances solution quality, efficiency, and generalization. Experiments demonstrate a highly competitive 0.25% optimality gap on TSP100, and the model exhibits excellent generalization capability in real-world applications.

items.title: Algorithm improvement based on scorpion hunting behavior
items.summary: This paper proposes a metaheuristic optimizer named SHSL (Simple Scorpion Hunting Strategy with Levy Flights), which integrates scorpion hunting behavior and Levy flight strategy. Based on the original SHS framework, SHSL introduces a collaborative mechanism involving boundary constraint and position update, and innovatively embeds Levy flight. Experimental results on CEC2017 benchmark functions and constrained engineering optimization cases demonstrate that SHSL effectively mitigates the drawbacks of SHS, including insufficient global exploration, premature convergence to local optima and low solution stability, achieving evidently better overall performance.
